Weighbridge automation: cotton, grain, building materials

Truck plate, weight and photos are recorded without human input, so “arrangements” at the scale and errors disappear. An MVP in 4–8 weeks, from UZS 72 mln; the full version in 10–16 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline
MVP 4–8 weeksFull 10–16 weeks

Agriculture, Construction, Manufacturing, Logistics

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Scale indicator integration
  • Plate recognition camera
  • Photos at each weighing
  • Gross, tare and net records
  • Printed and Telegram tickets
  • Export to 1C
What the full version adds
  • Several scales
  • Contracts and limits per supplier or farmer
  • Moisture and quality lab data
  • Payment calculation
  • Anti-fraud checks (repeat weighing, position sensors)

What we need from you

  • Site access and space for the devices
  • Internet or SIM cards
  • A budget for the hardware, which is not in the price

Questions

What does “Weighbridge automation: cotton, grain, building materials” cost?
The MVP costs $6,000–12,000 (UZS 72–145 mln), the full version $15,000–35,000 (UZS 180–425 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Weighbridge automation: cotton, grain, building materials” take?
The MVP takes 4–8 weeks, the full version 10–16 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Site access and space for the devices; internet or SIM cards; a budget for the hardware, which is not in the price.
